hypothesis_description: Do nothing: no position, no fees, no strategy drawdown; preserve capital except opportunity cost.
prior_failure_addressed: All failed active candidates lost to no-trade; establishes minimum hurdle.
frozen_rule_requirements: No entries, exits, orders, paper trading, or dry-run.
required_data_scope: No market data required except optional observation window metadata.
required_metrics: capital preserved; strategy fees 0; strategy drawdown 0; opportunity-cost notes.
pass_caution_fail_conditions: Pass/default if active candidates fail; caution if opportunity cost is high; never treated as active strategy.
overfitting_risks: None from trading rules; risk is misuse as proof that no future research is possible.
reasons_it_may_fail: Can underperform passive BTC in bull markets due opportunity cost.

hypothesis_description: Passive BTC exposure over the same window for opportunity-cost context.
prior_failure_addressed: BTC-relevant active strategies must justify activity versus passive exposure.
frozen_rule_requirements: Define start/end window and passive exposure assumption before comparison.
required_data_scope: BTCUSDT 4h or accepted BTC benchmark window; no active entries/exits.
required_metrics: passive return; passive drawdown; comparison to no-trade and active candidates.
pass_caution_fail_conditions: Not an active pass/fail candidate; used as benchmark if BTC-relevant.
overfitting_risks: Cherry-picking benchmark window after seeing results.
reasons_it_may_fail: Passive drawdown may be unacceptable; does not prove active strategy edge.

hypothesis_description: A separate BTCUSDT-only research hypothesis with its own frozen gate, not a rescue of basket failure.
prior_failure_addressed: BTCUSDT is strategically important but failed in Long1, cooldown, and anti-chase.
frozen_rule_requirements: Must define exact BTC-only entry/exit/risk rules before validation; cannot reuse failed path without new hypothesis.
required_data_scope: BTCUSDT 4h chronological 70/30 split or separately approved new-data split; no BTCUSDT_1h unless predeclared.
required_metrics: net PnL; PF; max DD; win rate; avg/median trade; trade count; no-trade and buy-and-hold comparison.
pass_caution_fail_conditions: Fail if BTCUSDT holdout negative or PF < 1.00; pass requires positive holdout, PF >= 1.10 by default, controlled DD, and risk-adjusted context versus buy-and-hold.
overfitting_risks: BTC-only rescue bias; repeated filter attempts after BTC failures; small-sample/regime-specific success.
reasons_it_may_fail: BTCUSDT already failed across multiple frozen tests; may not beat no-trade or passive BTC.

hypothesis_description: Long-only candidate active only in a predeclared trend/range regime.
prior_failure_addressed: Failed holdout transfer and whipsaw suggest a regime mismatch.
frozen_rule_requirements: Must define regime classifier, timeframe, lookback, and allowed state before validation.
required_data_scope: Same 19 local 4h markets; chronological 70/30 split; BTCUSDT and DOGE/DOT/UNI visible.
required_metrics: tournament metrics plus trades by regime and skipped regime counts.
pass_caution_fail_conditions: Fail if aggregate holdout negative, PF < 1.00, BTC negative when BTC-relevant, or breadth/concentration poor.
overfitting_risks: Regime labels tuned to prior failures; post-result state selection.
reasons_it_may_fail: Regime filter may reduce activity without improving expectancy, as cooldown/anti-chase did.

hypothesis_description: Candidate gated by a fixed volatility regime such as ATR percentile or compression/expansion state.
prior_failure_addressed: Filters may need to avoid periods where entries lack follow-through.
frozen_rule_requirements: Must define volatility measure, lookback, percentile/bucket, and allowed state once, before validation.
required_data_scope: Same 19 local 4h markets; chronological 70/30 split; no new OHLCV unless approved.
required_metrics: tournament metrics plus skipped trades by volatility state and fee-adjusted comparison.
pass_caution_fail_conditions: Fail if only trade reduction occurs without expectancy improvement; pass requires positive holdout and no-trade outperformance.
overfitting_risks: ATR/volatility threshold sweep under another name.
reasons_it_may_fail: May reproduce anti-chase failure: fewer trades/fees but worse or still negative PnL.

hypothesis_description: Predeclared market-family framework comparing majors, large alts, and smaller/alts without post-result cherry-picking.
prior_failure_addressed: Prior results showed market-family differences and weak-market drag.
frozen_rule_requirements: Families must be defined before testing; no market removal after results.
required_data_scope: Same 19 local 4h markets; DOGE/DOT/UNI remain visible; BTCUSDT visible.
pass_caution_fail_conditions: Cannot pass if it hides weak markets; any family-specific candidate requires separate confirmation.
overfitting_risks: Disguised market cherry-picking; excluding losers after seeing results.
reasons_it_may_fail: Family split may not transfer or may leave too little breadth.

hypothesis_description: Continue observation-only monitoring rather than active validation.
prior_failure_addressed: All active candidates failed; preserves context without negative-edge trading.
frozen_rule_requirements: No entries, exits, orders, paper trading, dry-run, or live-readiness claims.
required_data_scope: Optional benchmark observations only; no required OHLCV fetch.
required_metrics: periodic benchmark notes, data quality notes, regime observations; no active PnL.
pass_caution_fail_conditions: Default if active candidates fail or no fresh hypothesis is approved.
overfitting_risks: None from active rules; risk is accidental signal creation.
reasons_it_may_fail: Does not generate trading returns; only preserves capital/context.

hypothesis_description: High-risk research-only candidate exploring short/hedged framework only if separately justified.
prior_failure_addressed: Long-only family failed; however prior short-side evidence was weak/parked.
frozen_rule_requirements: Must have separate selection note and exact hedge/short rules; not immediately executable.
required_data_scope: Same 19 markets if basket; BTCUSDT visible if BTC-relevant; chronological split.
required_metrics: tournament metrics plus side-level exposure and downside contribution.
pass_caution_fail_conditions: High bar: fail on negative aggregate, PF < 1.00, poor BTC/breadth, or hidden short-side losses.
overfitting_risks: Reopening parked shorts; adding complexity to mask no edge.
reasons_it_may_fail: Prior short-only/reference work was negative; hedges can increase costs and complexity.
